scope: New caller-configured GPU composition/lifecycle primitive in runtime; no production Dock integration, native classifier/default thresholds, complete optics or native-parity acceptance.

postBuildDocumentationOnly.change: KDoc only: external source/relative transform contract, small foreground area, unavailable consumer-coordinate fallback and empty-source response. No logic or test edits and no rebuild after the comment change.

contract.response: All five BackdropForegroundResponse fields are explicit: lowBackground, highBackground, lowerLuma, upperLuma, opaque transparentBackground. No native classifier or default thresholds.
contract.source: Caller supplies the external scene with intended parent context, excluding this foreground and its own adaptive backing. Ordinary LayerBackdrop handles relative translation; relative scale/rotation requires LayerBackdrop.withTransformCompensation().
contract.sample: Finite positive Rect inside the modifier local physical-pixel size; five scene taps at center and(0.2,0.3),(0.8,0.3),(0.2,0.7),(0.8,0.7).
contract.mask: Only content alpha enters the neutral mask; caller accent/selected theme content remains outside. Source transparency composes over the explicit opaque fallback for luma.
contract.fallback: API<33, missing consumer coordinates or invalid sample rectangle draws original content; empty source uses the explicit transparentBackground for luma.
contract.retainedLayers: Three offscreen layers: original-sized mask, disjoint scene/mask atlas, separate completed output. Approximately five times logical content area in recordings; measured memory/performance unavailable.

build.scope: generic GPU foreground primitive and five host checks only; no Dock integration or native parity claim

initialHostFailure.rootCause: Compose Size.minDimension uses absolute dimensions; negative width passed the old positivity guard. Current primitive explicitly checks width > 0 and height > 0.

host.scope: Disjoint integer/fractional atlas packing, scene/sample separation, invalid/overflow dimensions and explicit response validation. Host tests do not establish optics.

device.capturePolicy: One requested OpticalCaptureWindow HWUI commit + PixelCopy per stage after waitForIdle; no retries, no compositor-first-presentation claim.

install.scope: Both installed APK identities verified and MainActivity resumed. Initial task-return transition screenshot and later stable home screenshot are retained separately; neither establishes native optical parity.

result.onlyNonexact: Three half-blue-on-white probes are(127,127,255), expected(128,128,255), for moved/resized/reattached consumers.
result.independentAccent: Orange badge remains exactly(255,128,0) in all seven consumer captures.
result.transparentSource: White response fallback chooses the high/blue endpoint while visible slate(32,64,96) remains through clear mask pixels; half blue is exactly(16,32,176).
result.resizeReattach: Resized and recreated consumers produce byte-identical PNGs; this is a requested committed capture, not the first compositor presentation.

packaging.scope: Current packaging119 classes includes6 new primitive classes; historical M3a22 sources/113 classes is unchanged evidence, not the current count.

coverageLimits: Generic rectangular synthetic mask, two opaque endpoint colors and 50% interior alpha only; no real glyph edge rasterization, partial endpoint alpha or intermediate luma response asserted.
No native iOS appearance/classifier, response threshold, sampling radius, hysteresis, motion, selected theme-color or complete Dock integration acceptance.
PixelCopy follows waitForIdle and a requested HWUI commit; it is not proven to be the compositor first presentation or a frame-by-frame source generation measurement.
GPU movement is translation and size change on one API36 device/density; no rotation, external scale, RTL, cross-window, other color space/API or invalid-geometry fallback test on hardware.
PixelCopy records final opaque window RGB, not intermediate shader alpha. Alpha is inferred from independent SRC_OVER colors in controlled backgrounds.

Mask-hole and corner probes cannot uniquely detect a scene repaint over an identical underlying opaque scene; transparent-source case and source/static checks constrain but do not prove absence of every leakage path.
Five identical-color source taps establish sample rect/endpoint reachability, not exact averaging weights or every tap position. Host tests establish packing independently, not optics.
The generic primitive is not integrated into production Dock. No selected Material token/color, full glyph acceptance, native material/classifier/hysteresis/timing or complete Dock acceptance.
Partial-alpha source, partial-alpha endpoint colors, intermediate smoothstep values and source replacement are not covered on hardware. No exact five-tap weights/positions acceptance.
Layer release is inspected in source; GPU resource counts, memory leaks and performance are not measured. Three retained offscreen layers are intended for small foreground areas.
The transform-compensation adapter is an explicit caller contract; scale/rotation are unverified on hardware in this batch.
evidenceStorage: External session artifacts are referenced by relative collection/directory and SHA-256. Raw videos/build outputs are not bundled in runtime; redistribution review remains open.
